versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 – Major update with new features, bug fixes, and improvements.

- Added file:// URL support; paths are auto-converted before adding.
- Audio generation now waits for completion (wait_for_audio).
- Detects and prevents duplicate notebooks by checking names before creating.
- Fixed full command argument passing bug with URLs/files/YouTube arrays.
- Improved error handling: add command now reports failure reasons clearly.
- Added --skip-audio flag to allow skipping audio generation in full workflow.
- Refactored initialization to use get_or_create_notebook; increased stability for wait_for_processing; debug mode now off by default.
